取不到文字时用屏幕识别兜底: Fall back to screen OCR when no text is captured
开着：复制/无障碍都拿不到字时，把拖选的那块屏幕识别一遍，认出来就弹条（微信、部: On: when neither the clipboard nor accessibility yields text, OCR the dragged region and show the bar if anything is recognised (needed by WeChat and some custom-drawn apps). Only applies when the selection is at least 8×8 px, so scrollbar drags do not trigger it; if OCR finds nothing, the bar still stays hidden.
